fluff.overview: After the Jihad stripped many elite units to fill battle armor companies, the LCAF recognized that conventional infantry remained essential for roles that battle armor could not cost-effectively fill. Mechanized hover platoons ride into battle aboard hovercraft that provide both speed and the ability to cross water and rough terrain without slowing, making them effective rapid-reaction forces. Equipped with Maxell PL-10 laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the more effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
